shutdownVerdict: read-heavy-09: Trace a cancellation leak in the document-rendering pipeline

cancellationBreaks.statement: ReadAllAsync is called without stoppingToken, so an idle worker cannot observe host shutdown.
Each render receives CancellationToken.None, explicitly severing shutdown cancellation from downstream HTTP.

componentExoneration: Renderer accepts and forwards a token to HttpClient; the queue is what discards it.
